purpose: Document local registry evidence, language-specific searches and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: Norfolk City’s Real Estate Assessor says it maintains city land records including parcel boundaries, and the City GIS Bureau publishes an official ArcGIS polygon parcel layer. This verifies a local parcel-record custodian and a public geometry candidate; a bounded feature query timed out without HTTP response, so no sample is claimed. Public polygon layer metadata verified, but no geometry sample retained: bounded MapServer and FeatureServer requests around the unchanged WUP point both timed out at 12 seconds with no HTTP status. Geometry is therefore an unverified candidate, not an absence claim.

Public City GIS metadata describes a city parcel polygon feature layer and supports JSON/GeoJSON; only the safe OBJECTID was specified in attempted bounded queries.
